MARKUS WEBER
Data Analyst
markus.weber@example.de  -  Berlin

PROFILE
Analyst with a background in economics. Comfortable with SQL and Python, presenting to stakeholders.

EXPERIENCE
Zalando SE, Berlin  -  Junior Data Analyst  -  09/2022 - present
* Weekly dashboards in Looker for the returns team
* Ad-hoc SQL analyses (BigQuery) for category managers
* Helped with an A/B test analysis for the checkout page

Deutsche Bahn, Frankfurt  -  Working student, Controlling  -  2020 - 2022
* Excel reports
* Data cleaning in Python (pandas)

EDUCATION
Goethe University Frankfurt  -  M.Sc. Economics  -  2022
Goethe University Frankfurt  -  B.Sc. Economics  -  2020

SKILLS
SQL, BigQuery, Python (pandas), Looker, Excel, German (native), English (C1)
